rationale.usefulness: Concrete upgrade and configuration-review guidance is valuable for builders using this CLI/library with custom providers. The education, backend and media-automation examples correctly propose synthetic local regression tests rather than claim deployed integrations or measured benefits. Missing configured-key storage is distinguished from an absent api_key_name setting, so the reader can identify the two different triggers. Value is substantial for the defined audience but does not extend to all AI users.
rationale.impact: Preventing unintended credential forwarding is consequential for affected installations, but the evidence concerns two conditional paths in one client and supplies no adoption, exposure or exploitation counts. This is a targeted security maintenance improvement with useful general engineering lessons, not a field-wide capability advance. I independently rate significance 4; this score is not selected to fit the submitted length.
rationale.novelty: The change repairs credential isolation and delegation defaults, using familiar missing-key failure and client-state propagation techniques. The specific bugs are newly documented, but there is little demonstrated new technical capability or broadly differentiated approach.
rationale.maturity: A versioned release and two maintainer-published advisories corroborate the fix, exact ranges and Moderate severity. Release notes confirm the missing-key error and delegated-path behavior, while setup documentation supplies established upgrade routes. Reporter-authored reproduction and suite results support readiness but were not independently rerun; the report makes that limit explicit. No claim of universal integration safety is made.
rationale.openness: The captured complete Apache 2.0 license, public advisory bodies, visible patch proposals and synthetic reproduction examples provide strong inspectability and reproducibility. The evidence supports an openly inspectable software tool; it does not imply model weights or training data are supplied. A maximum score would require stronger independently verified end-to-end reproducibility.
